# Routes the public API marks x-destructive (an AI app key needs the delete
# scope for them), from the OpenAPI document at
# https://docs.pantechdynamics.com/openapi/public-api.yaml. Keep in sync with it.
DELETE /certificates/{certificate_id}
DELETE /databases/{database_id}
DELETE /databases/{database_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}
DELETE /dns/zones/{zone_id}
DELETE /dns/zones/{zone_id}/records/{record_id}
DELETE /firewall-rules/{rule_id}
DELETE /iam/policies/{policy_id}
DELETE /iam/teams/{team_id}
DELETE /instances/{instance_id}
DELETE /instances/{instance_id}/private-network
DELETE /kubernetes-clusters/{cluster_id}
DELETE /kubernetes-clusters/{cluster_id}/node-pools/{pool_id}
DELETE /load-balancers/{load_balancer_id}
DELETE /migrations/{migration_id}
DELETE /networks/{network_id}
DELETE /port-forwarding-rules/{rule_id}
DELETE /public-ips/{public_ip_id}
DELETE /registry/repositories/{repository_id}
DELETE /registry/repositories/{repository_id}/tags/{tag}
DELETE /registry/tokens/{token_id}
DELETE /security-groups/{security_group_id}
DELETE /snapshots/{snapshot_id}
DELETE /ssh-keys/{ssh_key_id}
DELETE /subnets/{subnet_id}
DELETE /volumes/{volume_id}
DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}
